Name: Ash's Ginger Island Sauna and Farmhouse Redesign
Author: Tortart
Description:
This felt like a nice addition to the Ginger Island farmhouse that also pairs well with the redesign I made for the mainland farmhouse. Can't have an island home without somewhere to relax after all :)
